child_tool_info.description: Compare alignment-position symbol counts among supplied metadata groups with BV-BRC MetaCATS, using the supplied aligned FASTA and metadata file.
child_tool_info.instructions: Use input_type=files with the actual alignment_file and group_file, and alphabet=na or aa. This path stages the supplied alignment and metadata rather than running MAFFT. Retain complete original FASTA and metadata bytes, full headers, exact category columns and sequence-to-metadata joins. The producer passes its files-mode header flag to metadata_parser; declare the actual metadata layout for extraction. Do not uppercase supplied file sequences merely because the separate groups and auto branches do so. Original # symbols and generated masks of leading/trailing dashes require different provenance, including for all-gap rows. Preserve the native p_value cutoff, complete actual alignment and metadata, adjusted count matrix and raw R outputs when acquired, and native chi-square and pairwise export tables. The normal upload list does not guarantee original metadata, adjusted sequences, the count matrix or raw R files; missing operands remain explicit acquisition requirements. Use the metacats_input_fasta reader where original # characters must be retained. Biological groups, native group ordinals, R column tokens and exported labels are different associations. Native R reproduction requires its actual order evidence; biological grouping does not. Specify separate biological and native-reproduction requests. Retain raw counts, pseudocounts, expected counts, chi-square, degrees of freedom, p-values/log tails and effect components separately. The native pairwise degrees-of-freedom and underflow conventions must not replace the biological calculation. Native NA, underflow, measured zero and unavailable remain distinct. The exported p<cutoff rows do not establish the tested population. Multiplicity needs the complete eligible family or an explicit supported denominator/assumption. Empty exports do not prove zero tests. Keep analysis and category identities in each family; the same category label in two analyses is not an identity join. These statistics measure the selected association, not a calibrated probability of gene function. Where this entry exposes a launch route, commission the existing launch episode and its selected API child with the original job and constraints. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the selected application, parameters, input bindings and output destination without submitting. Input transfer uses separately selected workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload operations when needed. submit performs the selected primitive AppService.start_app2 call and retains its actual request, response and task identity. Use the generic resource monitoring task with selected status/query_tasks and task_info stdout or stderr observations. Preserve native state, observation time and logs; process liveness does not establish throughput. The episode chooses further observations and repairs; there is no fixed polling cadence or automatic retry. The existing results episode selects task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download as needed for the original task's actual files. A filename, HTML report or directory entry does not prove numerical format or original producer-byte identity. Preparation, transfer and task receipts do not receive invented annotation-confidence scores. This configured API route does not establish live authentication, deployment or local/HPC scientific execution. Select exact artifact roles, analysis-local slots, native reader formats and dialects, populations, calculation requests and the parent's typed return before acquisition. A bundle role selects the exact original output requirement's role; do not infer it from a filename. Supply source-backed member/row, feature/genome, function/taxon, transformation and category associations through scientific_inputs and supplied_metadata. Additional files need their original supplied_contents bindings and complete bytes. Source labels inside JSON do not authenticate a claim. The adapter's native parsers and metadata extractors fill the numerical sheet; separate deterministic calculators consume that sheet and explicit parameters. Those functions perform no acquisition, job, resource or model operation. Use the finite requested_form_schema selectors for the needed native measurements, calculated components, selected positions/tests and qualifications. Keep full bytes, associations, sheets and component sets internally, including valid partial work and unrelated failed analyses. Recalculate saved sheets with changed explicit parameters without reacquiring data or rewriting historical observations. Return only the original requested typed facts through the bvbrc_alignment return sources. No extra model call restates recorded facts; no full sheet or parent yield history is inserted into the child's instructions.
